g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
How to Mask Personal Information in Windows Screenshots
and Check for Original Traces
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-23
The safest order is to mask
information before capturing
If you remove or blur personal information on
the original screen before capturing, you reduce
the editing steps.
Check Snipping Tool’s masking features
Microsoft Support explains that you can add
marks to the screen with a pen, highlighter, or
shapes after capturing ([Microsoft Support - How…
Save under another name and avoid
overwriting
BleepingComputer reported in March 2023 that, in
Windows 11 Snipping Tool, cropping an existing
PNG file and saving it under the same name could…
Check the end of the saved PNG file
A PNG file should end with a final chunk called
IEND.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
